description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose UI component called HomeRail, which renders a horizontally scrollable rail of content cards for an Android TV application. It includes logic for layout, sizing, theming, and handling different section types like 'Seguí viendo' and 'Canales de TV'. The component manages focus behavior suitable for TV navigation and varies the card sizes and spacing based on the section title. It also references external theme and model classes.

methods.name: HomeRail
methods.description: Composable function rendering a focusable horizontal rail of cards for different sections, with layout and styling based on section title.
